a: Team sync: Settings > Shared accounts. Rust team_sync.rs encrypts (team passphrase -> PBKDF2 -> AES-GCM) and stores in Firestore team/{meta,marker,data}; polls only team/marker each minute. Secrets shared = Credential Manager services in SHARED_SERVICES plus SHARED_FILES (video-sources.json); add new shared secrets there. Workspace parts (brands, accounts, channels, categories, setup) are 3-way merged in src/workspaceSync.ts; App.tsx serialises saves and syncs (exclusive queue) and replays stale saves with mergeWorkspaces. Approved review posts are claimed with claim_review_post so only one PC publishes. Release-installed apps (SOCIALSPACE_RELEASE_CHANNEL, .github/workflows/release.yml) update from GitHub releases.

a: autofill.rs FILL_SCRIPT fills fields on every page/step (MutationObserver + page_loaded), opens TikTok/Instagram birthday menus (role=combobox) and picks options but never presses buttons, shows step hints in the top banner (TikTok QR, puzzles, phone checks) and a bottom-right code box with Copy. TikTok opens straight on /signup/phone-or-email/email. Wizard shows SIGNUP_FLOWS steps and its own code toast. Flows are documented in docs/signup-flows.md.

a: Each SeriesCharacter has an imageFile (brand-images name, synced). episodeRequest in src/series.ts ties pictured characters to <IMAGE_n>; generate_video takes references (file names), video_gen.rs reads them as data URLs and grok.rs sends reference_images (max 7, clip max 10 s). Kling can't take references, so characters are described in words.

a: BrandProfiles.tsx (brand Accounts tab) saves bios/keywords, then openProfileEditor -> posting.rs open_profile_editor opens the edit page in the brand's signed-in window (open_signed_in, profile_dir) with Posting.profile_script = autofill::profile_edit_script (replace once, watch 10 min, never presses Save). URLs in profile_edit_url: IG accounts/edit, X settings/profile, TikTok @handle (Edit profile), YouTube Studio. Sign-in and profile fills keep separate observers (signInOnly). Grok copy from assistant/profileWriter.ts; ghost text in GhostText.tsx.
